reasons.dev-error: expects an error that is only raised in dev mode, in Svelte as well
reasons.dev-log: expects something on the console that is only printed in dev mode, in Svelte as well
reasons.dev-message: compares the text of a warning or an error, which outside of dev mode is only a link, in Svelte as well
reasons.error-name: expects an error by its name, where a production build of svelte-lite has a number (`error-codes` in scope.json)
reasons.terser-unused-read: reads state in a statement of its own to depend on it, which terser takes for unused and drops, with Svelte as well
reasons.v8-message: compares the text of an error as V8 words it, and the bundles run in Bun
reasons.vitest: uses `vi` or `expect` of vitest, which is not there in a bundle
